text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Now then, I've successfully made my Debut.
choice_data_list: That's the first step, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: With this, we have finally made our official entry into the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The preparations for claiming the crown are complete.
Now, Trainer, show me what your capable hands can do."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The path we should strive for lies in the Classic Year, a little further ahead.
So then, what race should we challenge right now in the Junior Year?"

The path Symboli Rudolf must aim for is the Classic Triple Crown.
In other words, she will be walking the royal road of highest difficulty.

If that's the case, without overdoing it in the Junior Class,
I'd like to suggest something like the Saudi Arabia Royal Cup.
So with that in mind...
choice_data_list: How about the Saudi Arabia RC?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ho... That's an unexpected choice.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, races that determine the strongest of the Junior Class like the
"Asahi Hai Futurity Stakes," or—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I thought you'd be interested in
the Hopeful Stakes, though."

True, there are races to decide the Junior Class champion.
Even so, there's no need to push yourself now with
a grueling race schedule.
choice_data_list: All for the glory of the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh... I see, I like it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then why don't we take on the Saudi Arabia RC?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then let's move on to the next meeting right away—
(Patter-patter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, there you are!
Symboli Rudolf-san!!

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on your debut!
Please, give us a few words on how you feel right now!
choice_data_list: I'm sorry, right now is a bit...

text_block_list.text:
...Before I knew it, a large crowd of reporters had gathered.
It was right after a crucial debut race, so just as I was about to
turn them down to let her catch her breath...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, I don't mind at all.
Please let me take the interview.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's no problem at all. As I said before the race,
there's no reason to let an opportunity for the spotlight slip by.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I would love to hear what you have to say. Let's take them in order, then.

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
I'll go first! You've made a successful debut,
so what are your prospects going forward?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, we'll be aiming for the Classic Triple Crown.
To achieve that, first in the Junior Class—

At Symboli Rudolf's earnest insistence, we spent hours answering all the reporters.
By the time we returned to the academy, evening had already fallen...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ――Now then, I shall take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You must be tired today as well.
Please get some good rest.
choice_data_list: I'll take you back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not heading back to the dorm just yet.
I thought I'd finish up some Student Council work first.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Starting now, yes.
The interview wrapped up earlier than anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what I mean is, by 'expected', I anticipated
that the press corps would gather right after the race.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I received no notice that you'd be conducting an interview,
though not all media outlets go through the proper procedures.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Some reporters aren't looking for prepared statements—
they want to see your true nature when pushed to the brink.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's only natural to strike during the heightened post-race excitement. Especially against someone pretending to be flawless.

Compared to her, my own assumptions were naive.
Just as I was thinking I needed to reflect on my mistakes...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Come now, there is nothing for you to reflect upon.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
As the face of the academy, I've simply had more opportunities
than others to learn about handling interviews.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you'll be the liaison for the "Emperor."
You'll get used to it whether you like it or not, so look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, we've strayed from the topic,
so I'll go wrap up my work.
choice_data_list: You really should take today off to rest...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. I have no intention of
needlessly exhausting my stamina either, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now that you've debuted, you'll inevitably be
swamped with training and races going forward.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
That being said, I have no intention of slacking off
on my student council duties either.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If I cannot balance student council and racing—academics and athletics alike—
then how could I ever call myself the "Emperor"?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I understand that everything is built upon proper physical conditioning.
I will make sure my care is thorough.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That is all. Further discussion is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well then, Trainer-kun, see you tomorrow.

...I couldn't hold her back
any longer.

Symboli Rudolf is an exceptional Umamusume who reads her surroundings accurately and manages herself well.
Chances are, she won't rely on me very often.
Even so, I resolved to do everything in my power to be of help whenever she needed it. All to aid in making her dream come true...!
